messages:
anna: @here Quick update — weve added A100X-80GB dedicated capacity in ca-central-1 (2 AZs) and topped up eu-west-2. Reservations are live in the Console and via API. Docs: https://redwood.internal/dedicated/a100x-canada-eu

carlos: inventory note: ca-central-1 initial supply = ~4 racks, eu-west-2 added 3 racks. Temporary per-customer cap = 3 racks in ca-central-1 to ensure broad availability. Cap expires 2026-05-15 unless extended.

ops_engineer: fallback routing is enabled to L40s and shared H100s. Customers can set "preferred_fallback" in reservation payload to control routing priority. Expect small perf differences for long-context models.

customer-success: We're offering migration credits and a 1:1 migration planning slot for enterprise accounts reserving >=2 racks this quarter. Office hours scheduled Friday 16:00 UTC.

devops-bot: allocation created: dedicated:a100x:ca-central-1 (cap-17908). Policy template "dedicated-a100x-canada" published.

anna: TL;DR: A100X-80GB added to ca-central-1 + eu-west-2 top-up, reservations open, per-customer cap in CA=3 racks until 2026-05-15, fallback options available, contact @customer-success for migration help.
